headline.compliance: Most Wellcome-funded research meets the policy, and nearly all of it is free to read. So far in 2026, 68% of the research covered by the policy complies, 96% of journal articles are free to read and 84% are open access, up from 79% at this point in 2025.
headline.preprints_public_health: Where sharing findings widely and rapidly benefits public health, Wellcome-funded researchers preprint more. So far in 2026, 39% of virology articles covered by the policy were also shared as a preprint, against 33% across all subjects.

comparison.preprint_growth: Wellcome-funded researchers are sharing their findings sooner. They have posted 4,815 preprints so far in 2026, 20% more than at this point in 2025.

trend.das_share: More Wellcome-funded researchers are saying where their data can be found. In 2025, 82% of journal articles included a data availability statement, up from half in 2020.
